snippet.title: The Whims of the Gods Gameplay Trailer | Best Indie Games Fall Showcase 🍂
snippet.description:
🌋 Add The Whims of the Gods to your wishlist! ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642390/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=announcement_trailer

The Whims of the Gods is a strategic, cooperative city-builder created for joint gameplay in online co-op mode. Build and protect the ancient city, face enemies, and manage resources together! 🏠

🏠  Coming to Steam Early Access in 2025!
